using System;
using System.IO;
using Jellyfin.Server.Migrations.Routines;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Jellyfin.Server.Migrations.Routines.Tests
{
    public class MigrateUserDbTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<IServerApplicationPaths> _mockPaths;
        private readonly Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>> _mockDbFactory;
        private readonly Mock<IXmlSerializer> _mockXmlSerializer;
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<MigrateUserDb>> _mockLogger;

        public MigrateUserDbTests()
        {
            _mockPaths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
            _mockDbFactory = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>>();
            _mockXmlSerializer = new Mock<IXmlSerializer>();
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<MigrateUserDb>>();
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Perform_WhenRenamingLegacyUserDatabaseFails_LogsError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var dataPath = "/test/data";
            var dbFilename = "users.db";
            _mockPaths.Setup(p => p.DataPath).Returns(dataPath);
            _mockPaths.Setup(p => p.UserConfigurationDirectoryPath).Returns("/test/config");

            // Setup so migration proceeds to file rename
            _mockPaths.Setup(p => p.DataPath).Returns(dataPath);
            _mockDbFactory.Setup(f => f.CreateDbContext()).Returns((JellyfinDbContext)null!);
            _mockXmlSerializer.Setup(s => s.DeserializeFromFile(It.IsAny<Type>(), It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(new object());

            var sut = new MigrateUserDb(_mockLogger.Object, _mockPaths.Object, _mockDbFactory.Object, _mockXmlSerializer.Object);

            // Setup IOException scenario by making directory read-only or similar
            var dbPath = Path.Combine(dataPath, dbFilename);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(dataPath);
            File.WriteAllText(dbPath, "test");

            // Make the file read-only to trigger IOException on Move
            var fileInfo = new FileInfo(dbPath);
            fileInfo.IsReadOnly = true;

            // Act
            sut.Perform();

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(m => m.ToString().Contains("Error renaming legacy user database to 'users.db.old'")),
                    It.IsAny<IOException>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Perform_WhenUserDbDoesNotExist_LogsWarning()
        {
            // Arrange
            _mockPaths.Setup(p => p.DataPath).Returns("/test/data");

            var sut = new MigrateUserDb(_mockLogger.Object, _mockPaths.Object, _mockDbFactory.Object, _mockXmlSerializer.Object);

            // Act
            sut.Perform();

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Warning,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(m => m.ToString().Contains("doesn't exist, nothing to migrate")),
                    It.IsAny<object[]>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, object[], string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

using Xunit;

namespace Jellyfin.Server.Migrations.Routines.Tests
{
    public class MigrateUserDbTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<MigrateUserDb>> _mockLogger;
        private readonly NullLogger<MigrateUserDb> _nullLogger;

        public MigrateUserDbTests()
        {
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<MigrateUserDb>>();
            _nullLogger = new NullLogger<MigrateUserDb>();
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Perform_WhenRenamingLegacyUserDatabaseFails_LogsError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var tempDir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")[..8]);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(tempDir);
            try
            {
                var dataPath = tempDir;
                var dbFilename = "users.db";
                var dbPath = Path.Combine(dataPath, dbFilename);
                File.WriteAllText(dbPath, "test content");

                // Make file read-only to trigger IOException on Move
                new FileInfo(dbPath).IsReadOnly = true;

                var mockPaths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
                mockPaths.Setup(p => p.DataPath).Returns(dataPath);
                mockPaths.Setup(p => p.UserConfigurationDirectoryPath).Returns(Path.Combine(tempDir, "config"));

                var mockDbFactory = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>>();
                mockDbFactory.Setup(f => f.CreateDbContext()).Returns((JellyfinDbContext)null!);

                var mockXmlSerializer = new Mock<IXmlSerializer>();
                mockXmlSerializer.Setup(s => s.DeserializeFromFile(It.IsAny<Type>(), It.IsAny<string>()))
                    .Returns(new object());

                // Setup so migration proceeds to file rename section
                // Mock the SQLite connection/query to return table exists
                var sut = new MigrateUserDb(_mockLogger.Object, mockPaths.Object, mockDbFactory.Object, mockXmlSerializer.Object);

                // Act
                sut.Perform();
            }
            finally
            {
                if (Directory.Exists(tempDir))
                {
                    Directory.Delete(tempDir, true);
                }
            }

            // Assert - verify LogError was called with the specific message
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.LogError(
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("Error renaming legacy user database to 'users.db.old'"))),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Perform_WhenUserDbDoesNotExist_LogsWarning()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockPaths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
            mockPaths.Setup(p => p.DataPath).Returns(Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "nonexistent.db"));

            var mockDbFactory = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>>();
            var mockXmlSerializer = new Mock<IXmlSerializer>();

            var sut = new MigrateUserDb(_mockLogger.Object, mockPaths.Object, mockDbFactory.Object, mockXmlSerializer.Object);

            // Act
            sut.Perform();

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.LogWarning(
                    It.IsAny<string>(),
                    It.IsAny<object[]>()),
                Times.AtLeastOnce);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.IO;
using Jellyfin.Server.Migrations.Routines;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Jellyfin.Server.Migrations.Routines.Tests
{
    public class MigrateUserDbTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<MigrateUserDb>> _mockLogger;

        public MigrateUserDbTests()
        {
            _mockLogger = new();
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Perform_WhenRenamingFails_LogsError()
        {
            // Arrange
            var tempDir = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N")[..8]);
            Directory.CreateDirectory(tempDir);
            
            var mockPaths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
            mockPaths.Setup(p => p.DataPath).Returns(tempDir);
            mockPaths.Setup(p => p.UserConfigurationDirectoryPath).Returns(Path.Combine(tempDir, "config"));

            var mockDbFactory = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>>();
            mockDbFactory.Setup(f => f.CreateDbContext()).ReturnsMockedDbContext();

            var mockSerializer = new Mock<IXmlSerializer>();
            mockSerializer.Setup(s => s.DeserializeFromFile(It.IsAny<Type>(), It.IsAny<string>()))
                         .Returns(new object());

            // Create users.db to pass existence check
            var dbPath = Path.Combine(tempDir, "users.db");
            File.WriteAllText(dbPath, "dummy");
            
            // Make read-only to force IOException
            new FileInfo(dbPath).IsReadOnly = true;

            var sut = new MigrateUserDb(
                _mockLogger.Object, 
                mockPaths.Object, 
                mockDbFactory.Object, 
                mockSerializer.Object);

            // Act
            sut.Perform();

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.LogError(
                    It.IsAny<IOException>(),
                    It.Is<string>(msg => msg.Contains("Error renaming legacy user database to 'users.db.old'"))),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void Perform_WhenUserDbDoesNotExist_LogsWarning()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockPaths = new Mock<IServerApplicationPaths>();
            mockPaths.Setup(p => p.DataPath).Returns(Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), Guid.NewGuid().ToString()));

            var mockDbFactory = new Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>>();
            var mockSerializer = new Mock<IXmlSerializer>();

            var sut = new MigrateUserDb(
                _mockLogger.Object,
                mockPaths.Object,
                mockDbFactory.Object,
                mockSerializer.Object);

            // Act
            sut.Perform();

            // Assert - LogWarning called with "doesn't exist" message
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Warning,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("doesn't exist, nothing to migrate")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }

    // Extension methods for cleaner mocking
    public static class MockExtensions
    {
        public static Mock<JellyfinDbContext> ReturnsMockedDbContext(this Mock<IDbContextFactory<JellyfinDbContext>> factory)
        {
            var dbContext = new Mock<JellyfinDbContext>();
            dbContext.Setup(c => c.Users).Returns(new Mock<DbSet<User>>().Object);
            dbContext.Setup(c => c.SaveChanges()).Returns(0);
            factory.Setup(f => f.CreateDbContext()).Returns(dbContext.Object);
            return dbContext;
        }
    }
}
